h1: Prince Edward County travel, stays & events guide
heroText: Prince Edward County works best as a base in Canada when you anchor days around Sandbanks Provincial Park, Picton and Wellington. Use those sights to understand the city's history, street life and visitor rhythm. Peterborough Regional Airport (YPQ) handles the main arrival flow, so hotel choice should balance the centre, transfer time and day-trip plans.

history.text: North Marysburgh, surveyed in 1785 and settled by Loyalist veterans, some of Hessian birth.
The county was created by Upper Canada's founding lieutenant-governor John Graves Simcoe on July 16, 1792.
Hillier, organized in 1823, and named after Major George Hillier, military secretary to Sir Peregrine Maitland.

On January 1, 1998, the Town of Picton, the villages of Bloomfield and Wellington, and the townships of Ameliasburgh, Athol, Hallowell, Hillier, North Marysburgh, Sophiasburgh, and South Marysburgh amalgamated to form a new municipality with the official legal name of Prince Edward County.
